000f5441fbf0.name: Mark of Tzeentch
000f5441fbf0.plain:
- Once per turn, the first time this unit fails a saving throw, that attack's Damage becomes 0.
- If this unit has the ICON keyword, improve the Armour Penetration of its models' ranged attacks by 1.

004d2a066e77.name: Mutated Beyond Reason
004d2a066e77.plain: This unit can't perform actions. The first time it is chosen to fight in each Fight phase, roll one D3: this unit gets the matching mutation from this ability's table until the end of the phase.

007ff89d1942.name: Conceal
007ff89d1942.plain: At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase: pick one of your ALPHA LEGION INFANTRY units. For the rest of the phase, whenever an enemy model shoots, it can't target that unit while that shooting is resolved, unless that unit is the closest eligible target or is within 12" of that model. This Stratagem costs 3 CP if that unit has a Power Rating of 10 or more, otherwise 2 CP.

00fe7ff02553.name: Fire Frenzy
00fe7ff02553.plain: In your opponent's Shooting phase, after an enemy unit finishes making its attacks: pick one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES HELBRUTE models that was hit by at least one of that enemy unit's attacks this phase and is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units. That HELBRUTE can shoot as if it were your Shooting phase, but its only allowed targets are the closest enemy unit, or an enemy unit with any models that targeted that HELBRUTE model, and in either case only an eligible target.

0151c889797a.name: Diabolist
0151c889797a.plain: Your opponent can't re-roll wound rolls for attacks against this WARLORD, and each time it would lose a wound, roll one D6 and ignore that wound on a 5+.

01bbb6c0b622.name: Flames of Spite
01bbb6c0b622.plain: You can re-roll this WARLORD's melee wound rolls, and any attack it makes deals 1 mortal wound to the target on an unmodified wound roll of 6. That mortal wound is in addition to the attack's normal damage.

02163080cb40.name: Skyreaper battery
02163080cb40.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll of attacks this weapon makes against an AIRCRAFT unit, and its attacks that are allocated to an AIRCRAFT unit have Damage 4.

027d65446ada.name: Lashing tongue
027d65446ada.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it gets 2 extra attacks with this weapon, and it can make no more than 2 attacks with this weapon.

033280e02ead.name: Exalted Possession
033280e02ead.plain: This WARLORD gets the DAEMON and DAEMONKIN keywords, a 4+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks, and better Strength, Attacks, Wounds and Move. It gains those keywords if it doesn't already have them. Add 1 to its Strength, Attacks and Wounds characteristics, and add 2" to its Move characteristic.

037987da50ee.name: Techno-venomous Mechatendrils
037987da50ee.plain: The bearer's Master of Mechanisms repairs restore up to 3 lost wounds instead of up to D3, and each hit from its Mechatendrils becomes 1 mortal wound. Each hit from its Mechatendrils deals 1 mortal wound to the target and then ends the attack sequence.

03993a7afcac.name: The Daemon's Eye
03993a7afcac.plain: At the start of your Shooting phase, pick one of your DEVASTATION BATTERY units within 6" of the bearer; its weapons deny enemy units cover this phase. Enemy units don't get the benefit of cover against that unit's weapons until the phase ends.

03c69a52500f.name: Cult Demagogue
03c69a52500f.plain: The CULT DEMAGOGUE model in this unit knows Dark Zealotry and one more prayer from the Prayers to the Dark Gods. During your Command phase, the CULT DEMAGOGUE can try to chant one prayer it knows, as long as no friendly model has already attempted that prayer this turn. Roll a D6; if you get 3+, the prayer is heard, and it takes effect until your next Command phase starts. For any heard prayer that this unit's CULT DEMAGOGUE chanted, distances and line of sight are measured from that model.

03c80982c6f9.name: Duellist's Pride
03c80982c6f9.plain: Each time this model is chosen to fight, if any models with an unmodified Weapon Skill of 3+ or better are within Engagement Range of it, add 3 to its Attacks until that fight is resolved. Each time one of this model's melee attacks is allocated to a model with an unmodified Weapon Skill of 3+ or better, add 1 to that attack's Damage.

04926348f7c4.name: Murderous Reputation (Aura)
04926348f7c4.plain: Aura: enemy units within 6" of this WARLORD lose the Objective Secured ability.

04d55c5033b1.name: Devastating Charge
04d55c5033b1.plain: Its bladed horn weapon has Strength 7 if this model made a charge move this turn.

058b41c5a830.name: Combi Weapon
058b41c5a830.plain: When you attack with this weapon, pick one profile or both. If you pick both, subtract 1 from every hit roll made with this weapon.

05d8f28cbe9b.name: Screaming Skies
05d8f28cbe9b.plain: At the start of your Movement phase: pick one of your NIGHT LORDS JUMP PACK units and take it off the battlefield. During the Reinforcements step of your next Movement phase, place it anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" from all enemy models. If that unit is still off the battlefield when the battle ends, it is destroyed.

06533490c2ca.name: Balefire tome
06533490c2ca.plain: The bearer's unit gets the PSYKER keyword (see below).

068fd15e7035.name: I Am Alpharius
068fd15e7035.plain: This WARLORD gets a second, random Warlord Trait, and if it is destroyed, another ALPHA LEGION CHARACTER can take over as your WARLORD. When you make this model your WARLORD, randomly roll one extra Warlord Trait for it (re-rolling duplicates) from any Warlord Traits table it can use, which you choose. If this WARLORD is destroyed, you can at once pick another ALPHA LEGION CHARACTER model in your army that has no Warlord Trait and give it a Warlord Trait: one that no other model in your army has, that the model can have, and that isn't I Am Alpharius. That model is your WARLORD for all rules purposes for the rest of the battle. Any mission objective, secondary objective or Agenda rules that trigger when your WARLORD is destroyed don't trigger until this new WARLORD is destroyed.

07493d156476.name: Dark Destiny
07493d156476.plain: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save. It can lose at most 3 wounds in any single phase; any further wounds it would lose in that phase are ignored.

08f3513a1179.name: Daemon Engine
08f3513a1179.plain:
- It has a 5+ invulnerable save.
- During your Command phase, it gets back 1 lost wound.

0a0e2984a157.name: Ritual Offerings
0a0e2984a157.plain: When one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES CULTISTS units destroys an enemy unit. For the rest of the battle: that CULTISTS unit passes Morale tests automatically; and each melee attack made by a model in that CULTISTS unit gets 1 added to its hit roll.

0a9d7be1247c.name: Mutated Invigoration
0a9d7be1247c.plain: Blessing: if this power is manifested, pick one of your <LEGION> units within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, add 1 to either the Strength or the Toughness of that unit's models. If the Psychic test result was 10+ and you picked a DAEMONKIN or DAEMON ENGINE unit, add 1 to both instead.

0bfe6ee2ae54.name: Malicious Volleys

waive.176: page number of the book reference for the bolt weapon definition, not a rule value

0c56aad887df.name: Will of the Arkifane - Unholy Mechanisms
0c56aad887df.plain: Until your next Command phase starts, one friendly TRAITORIS ASTARTES DAEMON ENGINE model within 3" of this model adds 1 to its hit rolls. You pick that model when you choose this ability, and it can't be a CHARACTER, AIRCRAFT or TITANIC unit.

0cb378fc98c4.name: Hover Jet
0cb378fc98c4.plain: In your Command phase, this model may start hovering. If it does, it loses the Airborne, Hard to Hit and Supersonic abilities and has a Move characteristic of 20" until your next Command phase begins.

0cb6f16abe89.name: Axe of dismemberment
0cb6f16abe89.plain: For each attack with this weapon, an unmodified hit roll of 6 deals 2 mortal wounds to the target and ends the attack sequence.

0cdcf459188a.name: One with the Shadows
0cdcf459188a.plain: Attacks against this WARLORD subtract 1 from the hit roll, and your opponent can't re-roll that hit roll.

0ce3afdb3d14.name: Void Shields
0ce3afdb3d14.plain:
This model has 2 void shields, and each one has 3 shield points. As long as at least one void shield remains, this model gets a 5+ invulnerable save against ranged attacks.

Whenever this model fails a saving throw against a ranged attack while it still has a void shield, it suffers no damage. Instead, for every point of damage inflicted, 1 shield point is removed from one of its void shields. A void shield that has started losing shield points must keep losing them to any further damage until it collapses. When an attack takes a void shield down to 0 shield points, the shield collapses: this model loses it, and any damage that attack had left over is lost. Void shields can't stop mortal wounds: every mortal wound still makes this model lose one wound as normal.

When your Command phase starts, any void shield this model has with fewer than 3 shield points left is restored to 3 shield points.

0d2af8fec0b5.name: Unnatural Regeneration
0d2af8fec0b5.plain: Each time one of this unit's models would lose a wound, roll a D6. On a 6, it does not lose that wound.

0de30f7dade6.name: Smoke Launchers
0de30f7dade6.plain: Once per game, in the Shooting phase, this vehicle can use its Smoke Launchers instead of shooting with any of its weapons. If it does, until your next Shooting phase, your opponent subtracts 1 from every hit roll for ranged weapons targeting this vehicle.

0de37d79f7c5.name: Drakescale Plate
0de37d79f7c5.plain: The bearer's Save characteristic is 2+, and attacks against it fail on an unmodified wound roll of 1-3. Those wound rolls fail whatever abilities the attacking model or its weapon has.

0f7a51439466.name: Revered Hosts
0f7a51439466.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your WORD BEARERS DAEMON units is chosen to fight. For the rest of the phase, you can re-roll the wound roll whenever a model in that unit makes a melee attack.

1179e8d20fe7.name: Grandfather’s Blessings
1179e8d20fe7.plain: In any phase, when one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES NURGLE units is chosen as the target of an attack. For the rest of the phase, any attack made against that unit fails on an unmodified wound roll of 1-3, whatever abilities the attacking model or its weapon has. This Stratagem costs 1 CP if that unit has 5 or fewer models, otherwise 2 CP.

11aa8d8afd9f.name: Scrambled Coordinates
11aa8d8afd9f.plain: At the start of the Reinforcements step, in your opponent's Movement phase: pick up to 2 of your ALPHA LEGION CORE units on the battlefield. For the rest of the phase, enemy units arriving as Reinforcements can't be set up within 12" of any of the units you picked.

1219b1323677.name: Veterans of the Long War
1219b1323677.plain: In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES INFANTRY or TRAITORIS ASTARTES BIKER units is chosen to shoot or fight. For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the wound roll of every attack made by a model in that unit.

143372912540.name: The Malefic Tome
143372912540.plain: The bearer knows one extra psychic power from one of the disciplines it can use, and adds 1 to its Psychic test each time it tries to manifest a power.

145ce717fc23.name: Remorseless
145ce717fc23.plain: When this unit takes a Combat Attrition test, you can ignore any or all modifiers to it.

1487bce4b7b5.name: Flawless Perfection
1487bce4b7b5.plain: Models with this trait can ignore hit roll, Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill modifiers, and an unmodified wound roll of 6 improves the attack's AP by 1. They can ignore any or all of those modifiers when they attack. AP is the attack's Armour Penetration characteristic.

1501ddc34d84.name: Skyshrike Missile
1501ddc34d84.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES INFANTRY models shoots a missile launcher at an AIRCRAFT unit: that weapon can make only one attack this phase for that model, but that attack gets 1 added to its hit roll. On a hit, the target suffers 2D3 mortal wounds and the attack sequence is over.

15156a9ec9de.name: Enigmatic Ally
15156a9ec9de.plain: If your army is Battle-forged and any CHAOS LORD models are in a CHAOS SPACE MARINES Detachment in your army, CYPHER can be added to that Detachment without using up an extra Battlefield Role slot.

1602b53283b8.name: Spirit Thief
1602b53283b8.plain: If this model destroys at least one enemy VEHICLE model with a melee attack, it can use its Corrupt Machine Spirits ability twice in each of your Command phases for the rest of the battle.

169ef81e7a34.name: Diabolic Strength
169ef81e7a34.plain: Blessing: if this power is manifested, pick one of your <LEGION> INFANTRY or <LEGION> CHAOS SPAWN models within 12" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, that model adds 2 to its Strength and to its Attacks.

1749904e6d16.name: Unending Destruction
1749904e6d16.plain: In your Shooting phase: pick one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES INFANTRY units (not a CULTISTS unit) that is performing an action. It can shoot this phase and its action doesn't fail.

17a89883cd3b.name: Chainfist
17a89883cd3b.plain: Subtract 1 from the hit roll of every attack made with this weapon. If such an attack is allocated to a VEHICLE model, its Damage characteristic is 3 for that attack.

19061b3f11db.name: Cranium Malevolus
19061b3f11db.plain: When your Shooting phase starts, each enemy VEHICLE unit within 9" of the bearer risks mortal wounds. Roll one D6 per unit: on a 4-5 it suffers D3 mortal wounds, or 3 mortal wounds on a 6.

195a72e76fe0.name: Sigil of decay
195a72e76fe0.plain: When a model in the bearer's unit attacks with a bolt weapon, an unmodified hit roll of 6 wounds the target automatically.

1ae95a3747d7.name: Cerberus neutron pulse array
1ae95a3747d7.plain: If the bearer Remained Stationary in your previous Movement phase, attacks from this weapon that are allocated to a model have Damage 6.

1aede295df44.name: Deadly Ambush
1aede295df44.plain: At the end of the Reinforcements step in your opponent's Movement phase: pick one enemy unit that arrived on the battlefield as Reinforcements during this phase. Until your next turn ends, whenever one of your ALPHA LEGION models attacks that unit, add 1 to the hit roll.

1b8da9d95964.name: The Burning Rod
1b8da9d95964.plain: At the end of every Fight phase, you can choose a unit within 1" of the bearer; it suffers 1 mortal wound.

1cae7b6e94f9.name: Warp Marked
1cae7b6e94f9.plain: Malediction: if this power is manifested, pick one enemy unit within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, add 1 to the wound roll each time one of your <LEGION> DAEMONKIN or <LEGION> DAEMON ENGINE models attacks that unit.

1cdf636ffbe5.name: Hover Jet (Heldrake)
1cdf636ffbe5.plain: In your Command phase, this model may start hovering. If it does, it loses the Airborne Predator, Hard to Hit and Supersonic abilities and has a Move characteristic of 20" until your next Command phase begins.

1d23495e40f7.name: Spitespitter - combi-weapon
1d23495e40f7.plain: This profile is used when this relic replaces the boltgun profile of a combi-weapon.

1db005bc4cfc.name: We Have Come for You
1db005bc4cfc.plain: When your opponent's Movement phase begins: choose one of your NIGHT LORDS CORE, NIGHT LORDS DAEMONKIN or NIGHT LORDS CHARACTER units. Until your next turn begins, enemy units within Engagement Range of it are unable to Fall Back, except those with the VEHICLE, TITANIC or AIRCRAFT keyword.

1e5d3bfdac1f.name: Trusted War-leader
1e5d3bfdac1f.plain: While this WARLORD is on the battlefield, you can roll one D6 for every Command point you spend on Stratagems; on a 5+, you get that Command point back.

1ecc5a5b945e.name: Unholy Vigour
1ecc5a5b945e.plain: In any phase, when one of your IRON WARRIORS MACHINE SPIRIT or IRON WARRIORS DAEMON ENGINE units is chosen as the target of an attack. For the rest of the phase, subtract 1 from the wound roll of every attack made against that unit. This Stratagem costs 3 CP if the unit has the TITANIC keyword, otherwise 2 CP.

1ef83976353a.name: Warp-sighted Butcher
1ef83976353a.plain: This model can perform a Heroic Intervention when it is within 6" horizontally and 5" vertically of an enemy unit, rather than the usual 3" horizontally and 5" vertically. When it makes a Heroic Intervention move, it can move up to 6", as long as it finishes either closer to the closest enemy model or in Engagement Range of an enemy CHARACTER unit. Every other Heroic Intervention rule still applies.

1f00372baec1.name: Architect of Destruction
1f00372baec1.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one IRON WARRIORS CORE or IRON WARRIORS VEHICLE unit that is within 6" of this WARLORD to use Wanton Destruction. Until your next Command phase starts, whenever a model in that unit attacks while your army's wanton act is Wanton Massacre or Wanton Slaughter, treat that unit as engaged in Wanton Destruction for that attack instead.

1f3abdbce969.name: Heldrake claws
1f3abdbce969.plain: Attacks from this weapon that are allocated to an AIRCRAFT model have Damage 4.

200a35c2cc94.name: Lord of Raptors
200a35c2cc94.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your BLACK LEGION CORE or BLACK LEGION CHARACTER units within 6" of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, each time a model in that unit attacks, you can re-roll the hit roll. If it is a RAPTORS unit, you can re-roll the wound roll as well.

205d5632ddd6.name: Master of the Union
205d5632ddd6.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your WORD BEARERS DAEMONKIN units within 6" of this WARLORD to boost its Strength and melee Armour Penetration. Until your next Command phase starts, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of that unit's models, and improve the Armour Penetration of their melee attacks by 1.

20d62cfce79a.name: Cannon Fodder
20d62cfce79a.plain: At the start of your opponent's Shooting phase: pick one of your IRON WARRIORS INFANTRY units, then pick one friendly IRON WARRIORS CULTISTS unit wholly within 6" of it. For the rest of the phase, enemy models can't target that IRON WARRIORS INFANTRY unit while that IRON WARRIORS CULTISTS unit is a closer eligible target.

217e7d822ba8.name: Armour of Badab (Aura)
217e7d822ba8.plain: Aura: your RED CORSAIRS CORE and RED CORSAIRS CHARACTER units within 3" of the bearer get an invulnerable save: 4+ for TERMINATOR models, 5+ for others.

21b0f045ed78.name: Sicaran laser cannon
21b0f045ed78.plain: If the bearer Remained Stationary in its previous Movement phase, attacks from this weapon that are allocated to a model have Damage 6.

2263d13ab3e9.name: Loyalty's Reward
2263d13ab3e9.plain:
Pick one bolt weapon the bearer has.
- That weapon now counts as a Relic for all rules purposes.
- Each time the bearer attacks with that weapon and the target has the IMPERIUM keyword, a hit inflicts one mortal wound on the target and ends the attack sequence.
- Each time the bearer attacks with that weapon and the target lacks the IMPERIUM keyword, if that attack wounds, it inflicts one mortal wound on the target and ends the attack sequence.

22a5d1262018.name: Vectors of Death
22a5d1262018.plain: If a Plague Marine carries 2 melee plague weapons, its Attacks characteristic is 3.

22b52b08ff96.name: Relentless Devastation
22b52b08ff96.plain: In your Movement phase, when one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES INFANTRY units (not a CULTISTS unit) makes a Normal Move or Advances: as long as it doesn't move again, that unit counts as having Remained Stationary until your Shooting phase ends.

2328cd4aa435.name: Explodes
2328cd4aa435.plain: If this TRANSPORT model is destroyed, roll a D6 before any models embarked in it disembark and before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

233f8d88b620.name: Honour the Prince
233f8d88b620.plain:
In your Movement phase or your Charge phase, after you pick one of your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN CORE or EMPEROR'S CHILDREN DAEMONKIN units to Advance or declare a charge:
- In your Movement phase: don't make an Advance roll for that unit; instead, add 6" to its models' Move characteristic until the phase ends.
- In your Charge phase: don't roll 2D6 for that unit's charge roll; instead, until the phase ends, its charge roll is D6+6.

234d5b2eae49.name: Covert Control
234d5b2eae49.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your ALPHA LEGION CORE units within 6" of this WARLORD to gain Objective Secured and shoot during actions. Until your next Command phase starts, that unit can shoot while performing an action and the action doesn't fail. It also has the Objective Secured ability; any of its models that already have that ability count as 1 extra model when working out who controls an objective marker.

24a049697970.name: Hydra's Teeth
24a049697970.plain: One of the bearer's bolt weapons becomes a Relic that can swap its normal attacks for one stronger Hydra's Teeth shot that hits automatically. Only a model with a bolt weapon can take this Relic. When you give it to a model, pick one of its bolt weapons; that weapon counts as a Relic for all rules purposes. Whenever the bearer is chosen to shoot, you can have that weapon fire a Hydra's Teeth bolt: it makes only one attack with that weapon, but that attack hits automatically, gets 2 added to its Strength and Damage, has its Armour Penetration improved by 2, and can't be saved with an invulnerable save.

24b8f27b89c6.name: Explodes (6"/D6/Transport)
24b8f27b89c6.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before taking it off the battlefield and before any models embarked in it disembark. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

24df90e7e47a.name: Herald of the Apocalypse (Aura)
24df90e7e47a.plain: Aura: each time an enemy unit within 6" of this model fails a Morale test, 1 extra model flees from that unit.

263353f7e80b.name: Supersonic
263353f7e80b.plain: Whenever this model makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, first turn it on the spot by up to 90° (this doesn't count towards the distance it moves), then move it straight forward. After that first pivot it can't pivot again.

27f33f57f469.name: Blood Surge
27f33f57f469.plain: Whenever an enemy unit is chosen to shoot and any of its attacks target this unit, check once those attacks are resolved: if they destroyed any models in this unit, this unit can make a Blood Surge move. If it does, any actions it is performing fail. Then roll one D6: each model in the unit can move up to that many inches, but has to end as close as it can to the closest enemy unit. The unit can't end this move in Engagement Range of an enemy unit other than that closest one. A unit can't make a Blood Surge move in a turn in which it disembarked from a destroyed TRANSPORT model, or while it is already in Engagement Range of any enemy units.

2834a19dd7f7.name: Misery of the Meek
2834a19dd7f7.plain: Once per battle, when any phase starts, the bearer can use this Relic to heal 3 lost wounds and gain extra attacks and aura range this turn. When it does, it regains 3 lost wounds, and until the end of the turn, add D3 to its Attacks characteristic and 3" to the range of its aura abilities (to a maximum of 9").

28512e611d05.name: Spiteful Endurance
28512e611d05.plain: In any phase, when one of your IRON WARRIORS HERETIC ASTARTES models would lose a wound because of a mortal wound. For the rest of the phase, whenever that model or another HERETIC ASTARTES model in its unit would lose a wound to a mortal wound, roll one D6. On a 5+, that wound isn't lost.

28b2911a470b.name: Fell Prayers
28b2911a470b.plain: At the start of any of your phases except your Command phase: pick one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES PRIEST models that has not chanted a prayer this turn. It can chant one prayer that no friendly model has chanted yet this turn. That prayer is heard automatically (don't roll), and its effect lasts until the start of your next Command phase.

29887be42c9a.name: Kharybdis storm launcher
29887be42c9a.plain: Choose one of the following profiles to make attacks with before you select targets.

2a26c535a454.name: Sacrificial Dagger
2a26c535a454.plain: Each time this model tries to manifest a Malefic discipline psychic power while within 3" of any of your <LEGION> INFANTRY units (other than DAEMONKIN and CULTISTS units), you can pick one of those units to sacrifice. If you do, the chosen unit suffers D3 mortal wounds and you may add 2 to that power's Psychic test.

2d9139a0620e.name: Frenzied Crawler
2d9139a0620e.plain: When this unit makes a charge roll, roll an extra D6, and you may ignore any or all of the modifiers to that roll.

2dc05ff05bee.name: Hydra's Wail
2dc05ff05bee.plain: Once per battle, the bearer can make a Stratagem your opponent just used cost 1 more CP for the rest of the battle. Use this Relic after your opponent uses a Stratagem other than Command Re-roll; from then on, they must pay 1 extra CP each time they use that Stratagem again.

2e062f765d0f.name: Black Rune of Damnation
2e062f765d0f.plain: - Subtract 1 from the wound roll of every attack made against the bearer's unit.

2e3957c77ce9.name: Dark Raider
2e3957c77ce9.plain: Once per turn, after one of your RED CORSAIRS CORE units within 6" of this WARLORD shoots in your Shooting phase, it can make a Normal Move. If it does, it can't declare a charge this turn.

2f2bc07a069f.name: Fellblade accelerator cannon
2f2bc07a069f.plain: Choose one of the profiles below to make attacks with before you select targets.

2f6751e044d1.name: Infernal Power
2f6751e044d1.plain: Blessing: if this power is manifested, pick one of your <LEGION> DAEMONKIN or <LEGION> DAEMON ENGINE units within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, each time a DAEMONKIN or DAEMON ENGINE model in that unit makes a melee attack, an unmodified hit roll of 6 wounds the target automatically. When that happens, rules triggered by a particular wound roll treat it as an unmodified wound roll of 6 for that attack.

2f7d68bb4ba7.name: Unholy Fortitude
2f7d68bb4ba7.plain: Your WARLORD ignores lost wounds on a 5+: roll one D6 whenever it would lose a wound, and on a 5+ that wound isn't lost.

2fe02a85ed16.name: Epistle of Lorgar
2fe02a85ed16.plain: The bearer knows one extra prayer from the Prayers to the Dark Gods and can chant one extra prayer in your Command phase. To chant that extra prayer it must be on the battlefield, and the prayer must be one it knows that no friendly model has already chanted that turn.

2fed897e432f.name: Sorcerous Master
2fed897e432f.plain: Whenever this unit manifests a psychic power, tries to perform a psychic action or tries to Deny the Witch, take all distances and line of sight from its Aspiring Sorcerer or Scarab Occult Sorcerer model. If an enemy unit has an ability that needs distance or line of sight measured to a PSYKER unit, measure to that same model.

30d29ace94a6.name: Hover Transport
30d29ace94a6.plain: Measure distances to and from this model's hull or its base, whichever is closer.

31b6edf7fdda.name: One Piece at a Time
31b6edf7fdda.plain: This WARLORD makes Combat Attrition tests harder for an enemy unit it has damaged, and its unit can consolidate in any direction. Each time it fights, once it has made all its attacks, if they destroyed any enemy models without wiping out the whole unit, pick one of those units: subtract 1 from its Combat Attrition tests until the end of the next Morale phase. When this WARLORD consolidates, the models in its unit can move in any direction, even if they are already in base contact with an enemy model, as long as each one ends its move within 3" of an enemy unit.

31b742ce66c8.name: The Armour Diabolus
31b742ce66c8.plain:
- The bearer's Save characteristic is 2+.
- Whenever an enemy unit shoots or fights and chose the bearer as a target for any of its attacks, then after that unit has made all of its attacks:
  - Roll a D6 for every wound the bearer lost to those attacks. Each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on the attacking unit.
  - If the bearer was destroyed by those attacks, roll a D6 before you remove it from play; on a 4+, D3 wounds are inflicted on the attacking unit.

329163551441.name: Delightful Agonies
329163551441.plain: Blessing: if this power is manifested, pick one of your <LEGION> SLAANESH units within 18" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, whenever one of that unit's models would lose a wound, roll a D6. On a 5+, the wound is ignored.

33130ab81422.name: Distortion
33130ab81422.plain: For each attack made with this weapon, choose one of the profiles below to make it with.

338a7d0d64ad.name: Forward Operatives
338a7d0d64ad.plain: In the Resolve Pre-battle Abilities step of your mission: pick one of your ALPHA LEGION INFANTRY units. It can make a Normal Move, treating it as your Movement phase, but it must finish that move more than 9" away from all enemy models. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice if you are playing a Strike Force or Onslaught battle. You can't pick the same ALPHA LEGION INFANTRY unit for this Stratagem more than once.

344131ea2c1f.name: Unstoppable Wrath
344131ea2c1f.plain: This model can attack with Blast weapons against units that are in Engagement Range of it. When it makes a ranged attack against an enemy unit in Engagement Range of it, add 1 to that attack's hit roll.

37a3183f1698.name: Explodes (2D6"/D3)
37a3183f1698.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 2D6" takes D3 mortal wounds.

37f1afc12df6.name: Daemon blade
37f1afc12df6.plain: Each time an attack is made with this weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 6 inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target as well as the normal damage.

380ce7c8dca1.name: Benediction of Darkness (Aura)
380ce7c8dca1.plain: If this prayer is heard, your <LEGION> CORE, <LEGION> CHARACTER and <LEGION> CULTISTS units wholly within 6" of this PRIEST have Light Cover against shooting. While such a unit stays wholly within 6" of this PRIEST, it counts as having the benefit of Light Cover against each ranged attack made against it.

382983c2b073.name: Fatal Sonancy
382983c2b073.plain: When your Movement phase ends, you can roll six D6 against one enemy unit within 12" of the bearer that it can see; each 4+ deals 1 mortal wound to that unit.

388975f720f9.name: Thermal jets
388975f720f9.plain: Once the bearer has moved, you may choose one unit it moved over and roll one D6, taking 2 off the roll if the unit has the CHARACTER keyword. On a 2-5, the unit suffers D3 mortal wounds; on a 6, it suffers D6 mortal wounds.

38ea87dcfbd1.name: Spitespitter - combi-bolter
38ea87dcfbd1.plain: This profile is used when this relic replaces a combi-bolter.

390878e9df08.name: Master of Mechanisms
390878e9df08.plain: At the end of your Movement phase, this model may repair one of your <LEGION> VEHICLE models within 3" of it, which gets back up to D3 lost wounds. A model can be repaired only once per turn.

3918d0802641.name: Living Carapace
3918d0802641.plain: Once per battle, the bearer can enhance this Relic as an attack is allocated to it, making every attack allocated to it Damage 1 until the end of the turn. From then until the turn ends, each attack allocated to the bearer has its Damage characteristic changed to 1.

3919eb7dd09d.name: Mantle of Traitors
3919eb7dd09d.plain: The bearer can use an Epic Deed Stratagem for 0CP once per battle, can re-roll melee hit rolls, and can extend some of its auras to one <LEGION> CORE unit. Once per battle, if the bearer is picked for an Epic Deed Stratagem, that Stratagem costs 0CP. You can re-roll hit rolls for its melee attacks. At the start of your Command phase, pick one of your <LEGION> CORE units on the battlefield: until your next Command phase starts, that unit counts as within range of the bearer's Lord of Chaos, Aspire to Glory and Demagogue aura abilities, if it has any of them.

391dd9581e75.name: Death Ecstasy
391dd9581e75.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN INFANTRY units is chosen as the target of a melee attack. For the rest of the phase, whenever a model in that unit is destroyed by a melee attack and it has not fought this phase, don't remove it from play yet. It can fight once the attacking model's unit has finished its attacks, and is removed from play after that.

3954388796ef.name: Explodes
3954388796ef.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before any models embarked in it disembark and before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

398889989814.name: Let the Galaxy Burn
398889989814.plain: This only applies if every unit in your army is a TRAITORIS ASTARTES unit (not counting AGENT OF CHAOS or UNALIGNED units) and every <LEGION> unit in it comes from one Legion, apart from ABADDON THE DESPOILER. If so, add 2 to the number of attacks this unit's flame weapons make. Your army also has one wanton act active: Wanton Destruction during battle round 1, Wanton Massacre during battle round 2, either Wanton Massacre or Wanton Slaughter (you choose) during battle round 3, and Wanton Slaughter during battle round 4 and every round after it. Each wanton act lists weapon types; while it is active, an unmodified 6 to hit with one of those weapon types scores 1 extra hit. Wanton Destruction lists Heavy, Rapid Fire and Grenade weapons, Wanton Massacre lists Rapid Fire, Assault and Pistol weapons, and Wanton Slaughter lists Assault, Pistol and melee weapons.

waive.145: page number of the book reference, not a rule value

39d2980e5afa.name: Hunter-killer missile
39d2980e5afa.plain: The bearer can fire each of its hunter-killer missiles only once per battle.

3a451f34bf95.name: Traitor's Laurels (Aura)
3a451f34bf95.plain: Aura: your RED CORSAIRS CORE units within 6" of the bearer can ignore any or all modifiers to their Combat Attrition tests.

3ba73ff71db1.name: Dark Disciples
3ba73ff71db1.plain: If this unit has any DARK DISCIPLES models, add 1 to the roll that decides whether each prayer it chants is heard. Ignore destroyed DARK DISCIPLE models when taking Morale tests. If this unit's DARK APOSTLE model is ever destroyed, every DARK DISCIPLE model left in this unit is destroyed too.

3bf332fe3e39.name: Soultearer Portent
3bf332fe3e39.plain: If this prayer is heard, one of your units within 6" of this PRIEST adds 1 to the wound roll of its melee attacks. Pick that unit from your <LEGION> CORE, <LEGION> CULTISTS or <LEGION> CHARACTER units; the bonus applies to every melee attack its models make.

3e6c6e18a1c9.name: The Tyrant of Badab
3e6c6e18a1c9.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your RED CORSAIRS CORE or RED CORSAIRS CHARACTER units within 6" of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, each time a model in that unit attacks, you can re-roll the hit roll.

3f80c691f061.name: Master’s Guidance
3f80c691f061.plain: At the start of your Shooting phase or of the Fight phase: until the phase ends, your WARLORD gains this ability: 'Master's Guidance (Aura): while one of your DAEMON ENGINE units is within 6" of this model, you can re-roll the hit roll each time a model in that unit makes an attack.'

3f880f9f5066.name: Cogitated Fates
3f880f9f5066.plain: In your Shooting phase, when one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES units is chosen to shoot. For the rest of the phase, targets of attacks made by models in that unit can't get the Benefits of Cover against those attacks.

3fa69d268c62.name: Vox Scream
3fa69d268c62.plain: At the end of your Movement phase: pick one enemy unit within 12" of one of your NIGHT LORDS units. Until your next Movement phase starts, that enemy unit loses all its aura abilities. You can use this Stratagem only once.

3fb103e7dafd.name: Explodes (Chaos Land Raider)
3fb103e7dafd.plain: If this TRANSPORT model is destroyed, roll a D6 before any models embarked in it disembark and before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

41a00698c6ef.name: Lord of the Traitor Legions
41a00698c6ef.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of your HERETIC ASTARTES CORE or HERETIC ASTARTES CHARACTER units within 6" of this model. Until your next Command phase starts, each time a model in that unit attacks, you can re-roll the hit roll. If it is a BLACK LEGION unit, you can re-roll the wound roll as well.

41c980942930.name: Angel of Hatred
41c980942930.plain: This WARLORD gets 1 extra Strength and Attacks when it fights in a turn in which it charged, was charged or made a Heroic Intervention. The bonus lasts until that fight is resolved.

4280b310b788.name: Cult Leader
4280b310b788.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your ALPHA LEGION CULTISTS units within 9" of this WARLORD to make its attacks more accurate and more piercing. Until your next Command phase starts, each attack a model in that unit makes adds 1 to its hit roll and improves its Armour Penetration by 1.

42b7acd078e5.name: Voidcutter
42b7acd078e5.plain: Add 1 to the wound roll for attacks this weapon makes against a VEHICLE unit.

437f4ff167c5.name: Putrid Explosion
437f4ff167c5.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before taking it off the battlefield. On a 4+, it explodes and every unit within 6" (other than NURGLE units) takes 1 mortal wound.

43b143c7e3f8.name: Will of the Arkifane
43b143c7e3f8.plain: In your Command phase, pick one of the Will of the Arkifane abilities.

43da9bcfdcb4.name: Scorn of Sorcery
43da9bcfdcb4.plain: In your opponent's Psychic phase, after an enemy PSYKER unit passes a Psychic test and after any Deny the Witch test has been taken: if that PSYKER unit is within 24" of any of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES KHORNE units, roll one D6. On a 4+, the psychic power is denied.

43dac232abb4.name: Veiled Agenda
43dac232abb4.plain: After you select secondary objectives or Agendas, if your army includes any ALPHA LEGION units: keep one of your selections hidden from your opponent. Reveal it the first time you score victory points or experience points for it. You must still record your selection; we suggest writing it down and keeping it hidden until you reveal it. You can use this Stratagem only once.

43e094addf90.name: Bastion
43e094addf90.plain: In your Command phase, you can pick one of your IRON WARRIORS CORE units within 6" of this WARLORD; it gains Objective Secured and can react to charges. These effects last until your next Command phase starts. When an enemy unit declares a charge against that unit, it can choose to Hold Steady or Set to Defend, as long as no enemy units are within Engagement Range of it. It also has the Objective Secured ability; any of its models that already have that ability count as 1 extra model when working out who controls an objective marker.

44628152ffb0.name: Paragon of Hatred
44628152ffb0.plain: You can re-roll charge rolls for this WARLORD, and it gets extra attacks when it fights. Whenever it fights while within Engagement Range of any enemy units, add 1 to its Attacks characteristic until that fight is resolved, or add D3 instead if any of those enemy units have the IMPERIUM keyword.

446c9ddbd444.name: Inferno Tome
446c9ddbd444.plain: The bearer knows an extra prayer, and each heard prayer deals D3 mortal wounds to the closest visible enemy unit within 18" of it. The extra prayer comes from the Prayers to the Dark Gods. The mortal wounds go to the closest enemy unit within 18" of the bearer that it can see, each time it chants a prayer that is heard.

44c92f5be897.name: Helbrute fist
44c92f5be897.plain: If the bearer has 2 Helbrute fists, it gets 1 extra attack with 1 of them whenever it fights.

4530beaea908.name: Cyclonic melta-lance
4530beaea908.plain: Blast. Attacks from this weapon against a unit within half range have Damage D6+2.

467fb15ea70e.name: Hexagrammatic Ward
467fb15ea70e.plain: In any phase, when an attack is allocated to one of your WORD BEARERS models: that attack's Damage characteristic becomes 0. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice if you are playing a Strike Force or Onslaught battle.

48f00dfd9757.name: Daemonic Allegiance
48f00dfd9757.plain:
When you add this model to your army, pick one of these: KHORNE, TZEENTCH, NURGLE or SLAANESH. This model has that Faction keyword until the battle ends.

If your army is Battle-forged, you must also give this model the Mark of Chaos matching that keyword. So if you chose Slaanesh, it gains the SLAANESH keyword and, in a Battle-forged army, must be given the Mark of Slaanesh.

If you picked TZEENTCH, NURGLE or SLAANESH, this model gets the PSYKER keyword. If you picked KHORNE, this model adds 1 to its Strength and Attacks.

49cc1b238662.name: Host Raptorial
49cc1b238662.plain: When you choose your army: pick one Chaos Space Marine Detachment in your army to be a Host Raptorial Specialist Detachment. The <LEGION> JUMP PACK units in it get the HOST RAPTORIAL keyword.

49e373f493c0.name: Icon of the Hydra Cult (Aura)
49e373f493c0.plain: Aura: while one of your ALPHA LEGION CULTISTS units is within 6" of the bearer, whenever a ranged attack is made against that unit by an attacker more than 12" away, the target unit gets Dense Cover benefits against it.

49eee1dbb427.name: Lasher tendrils
49eee1dbb427.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it gets 6 extra attacks with this weapon.

49f4d31e081b.name: Dirty Fighter
49f4d31e081b.plain: When the Fight phase starts, you can pick one enemy unit within 3" of this WARLORD; it can't fight this phase until every eligible unit of yours has fought.

4adcb45ee655.name: Loathsome Insights
4adcb45ee655.plain: While any of your NOCTILITH CROWN models are on the battlefield, your TRAITORIS ASTARTES PRIEST and TRAITORIS ASTARTES PSYKER units can attempt the Loathsome Insights action. Action: at the end of your Movement phase, one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES PRIEST or TRAITORIS ASTARTES PSYKER units that is wholly within 9" of one of your NOCTILITH CROWN models can begin this action. It completes at the end of your turn. When it completes, you gain 1 Command point, and you must then roll 2D6. If the total is equal to or lower than the Leadership characteristic of the unit that performed the action, you can pick one prayer from the Prayers to the Dark Gods (if it is a PRIEST unit) or one psychic power from one of the disciplines it has access to (if it is a PSYKER unit). For the rest of the battle, that prayer or psychic power replaces one prayer or psychic power that unit knows.

4bb4ef030e7c.name: Doom siren
4bb4ef030e7c.plain: Sonic Weapon. Every attack made with this weapon hits the target automatically.

4ca5f7b832c2.name: Bladed horn
4ca5f7b832c2.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it gets 3 extra attacks with this weapon, and it can make no more than 3 attacks with this weapon.

4cdf76ba5c9f.name: Hover Jet
4cdf76ba5c9f.plain: In your Command phase, this model may start hovering. If it does, it loses the Airborne Predator, Hard to Hit and Supersonic abilities and has a Move characteristic of 20" until your next Command phase begins.

4d4508addb18.name: Chaos Icon
4d4508addb18.plain: The bearer's unit gains the ICON keyword. Add 1 to every Combat Attrition test taken for the bearer's unit.

4e04f168a41f.name: Body of Unholy Artifice
4e04f168a41f.plain: This model has a 4+ invulnerable save, and each attack allocated to it has its Damage reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1).

4e971ae96136.name: Lord of Terror (Aura)
4e971ae96136.plain: Aura: while an enemy unit is within 6" of this WARLORD, your opponent rolls one extra D6 for each of its Morale tests and drops the lowest. If that unit fails a Morale test, it counts as below Half-strength for Combat Attrition tests until the phase ends.

4f33cd9efdda.name: Trophies of Slaughter
4f33cd9efdda.plain: - The range of the bearer's aura abilities is increased by 3" (up to a maximum of 9"). Aura abilities that are psychic powers don't get this increase.

4f70418294fe.name: Unrelenting Onslaught
4f70418294fe.plain: In your Movement phase, when you pick one of your BLACK LEGION units to move. Until your next Movement phase starts: that unit may ignore any or all modifiers to its Move characteristic, its Advance rolls and its charge rolls; and even if it Falls Back this turn, it can still shoot and declare a charge.

502fdbe32f8a.name: Ancient Enmity
502fdbe32f8a.plain: In the Fight phase, when one of your FALLEN ANGELS units is chosen to fight. For the rest of the phase, you can re-roll the wound roll whenever a model in that unit attacks a DARK ANGELS unit.

5037e3fbb72d.name: Gifts of Chaos
5037e3fbb72d.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the TRAITORIS ASTARTES keyword: pick one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES CHARACTER models and give it one Relic of Chaos that it is allowed to have. Every Relic in your army must be different. A MARK OF CHAOS CHARACTER model can get a second Relic from this Stratagem, as long as one of its Relics replaces a weapon; apart from that, this Stratagem can't give a model two Relics. If you give a CHARACTER model a second Relic this way, none of its Relics can be a daemon weapon. This Stratagem can never give a model three Relics. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or 3 times in an Onslaught battle.

50c9efdc4150.name: Secure the Prize
50c9efdc4150.plain: In any phase, when one of your RED CORSAIRS CORE units in range of an objective marker becomes the target of an attack. For the rest of the phase, when an attack that has a Damage characteristic of 1 is allocated to one of that unit's models, add 1 to any armour saving throw made against it.

516c160362b9.name: Tip of the Spear
516c160362b9.plain: At the start of your Charge phase, if none of your BLACK LEGION units are within Engagement Range of any enemy units: pick whichever of your BLACK LEGION CORE, BLACK LEGION DAEMONKIN or BLACK LEGION CHARACTER units is closest to an enemy unit. For the rest of the turn: charge rolls for that unit can be re-rolled; and each time one of its models makes a melee attack against an enemy unit that is within your opponent's deployment zone or in range of an objective marker, improve that attack's Armour Penetration characteristic by 1.

5181ba2538ad.name: Sightless Helm
5181ba2538ad.plain: The bearer's attacks can ignore hit and skill modifiers, get 1 better Armour Penetration, and deny the target the benefits of cover. For each attack the bearer makes, you may ignore any or all of the modifiers to its hit roll, Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill, and that attack's Armour Penetration is improved by 1. The target doesn't get the benefits of cover against it.

51a2a92159cb.name: Veilbreaker Plate
51a2a92159cb.plain: Attacks allocated to the bearer have their Armour Penetration worsened by 1, and once per battle it can redeploy with up to one nearby BLACK LEGION CORE unit. To redeploy, use this Relic in your Movement phase, as long as the bearer didn't arrive as Reinforcements this turn. Remove the bearer, and up to one of your BLACK LEGION CORE units within 3" of it, from the battlefield, and set them up again anywhere on the battlefield more than 9" from all enemy models. If two units are set up again this way, they must be placed within 6" of each other.

51b11070c600.name: Masters of Duplicity
51b11070c600.plain: Ranged attacks from more than 12" away subtract 1 from the hit roll against units with this trait, and these units can act or charge after Falling Back. If a model in the target unit has a Wounds characteristic of 10 or more, the penalty needs the attacker to be more than 18" away instead. These units can perform an action or declare a charge in the same turn they Fell Back, but if one declares a charge while performing an action, that action still fails.

5245f047e4a8.name: The Burning Rod
5245f047e4a8.plain: Only a model with a force stave can take The Burning Rod. It replaces that force stave and has its own weapon profile.

5287d8ede3fc.name: Heavy armour
5287d8ede3fc.plain: The bearer gets a 5+ invulnerable save.

5336e419de3f.name: Demagogue (Aura)
5336e419de3f.plain: Aura: while one of your <LEGION> CORE, <LEGION> DAEMONKIN or <LEGION> CULTISTS units is within 6" of this model, its models may use the Leadership of this model in place of their own.

539ad23f55cb.name: Flayer
539ad23f55cb.plain: In the next Morale phase, each enemy model destroyed by an attack with this weapon is counted as 2 destroyed models.

53e49c295ac7.name: Artillery and Crew
53e49c295ac7.plain: Each Rapier Carrier and its crew count as one model for all rules purposes, and the crew models must stay within 1" of their Rapier Carrier model. So the crew models can't be targeted or attacked on their own, and visibility and range are measured to and from the Rapier Carrier model rather than the crew. This unit can't Advance, is never eligible to charge or perform a Heroic Intervention, and can't make pile-in or consolidation moves.

53ebadce675e.name: Martial Legacy
53ebadce675e.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, any Detachment that includes this unit has its Command Cost raised by 1CP.

54241b2cd7ac.name: Techno-virus injector
54241b2cd7ac.plain: When the bearer attacks a VEHICLE unit in melee, add 1 to that attack's Damage.

54726bd4859a.name: Slaughterborn
54726bd4859a.plain: Each time an attack by this WARLORD destroys an enemy CHARACTER, MONSTER or TITANIC model, add 1 to its Attacks and Strength for the rest of the battle.

56e834946654.name: Soulburner petard
56e834946654.plain: When the bearer shoots, if any attack with this weapon gets an unmodified hit roll of 1, the bearer suffers 1 mortal wound once it has finished shooting with this weapon. For each attack with this weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 2+ deals 1 mortal wound to the target and ends the attack sequence.

571df4c30432.name: Flail of corruption
571df4c30432.plain: Plague Weapon. For each attack made with this weapon, you make 2 attack rolls rather than 1.

57ed0a0f64f7.name: Balefire tome
57ed0a0f64f7.plain: Whenever this unit tries to manifest a psychic power, perform a psychic action or Deny the Witch, take all distances and line of sight from the model in it that carries the balefire tome. If an enemy unit has an ability that needs distance or line of sight measured to a PSYKER unit, measure to that same model.

57f50c1cc8e1.name: The Hamadrya
57f50c1cc8e1.plain: Once per battle, when your Psychic phase starts, this model may use its Hamadrya. If it does, until the phase ends it gains the PSYKER keyword and can attempt to manifest one psychic power: either Smite or one from the Dark Hereticus discipline.

5807b2fe1ece.name: Explodes
5807b2fe1ece.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

5824feac7536.name: Dark Council
5824feac7536.plain: Whenever this model chants a prayer, you may re-roll the roll that decides whether the prayer is heard.

596683dcad55.name: Bringers of Despair
596683dcad55.plain: At the start of your opponent's Fight phase: pick one BLACK LEGION CHAOS TERMINATOR SQUAD unit that has at least one enemy unit within 3" of it. It can fight, and it fights first this phase. For the rest of the phase, its models get 1 added to their Attacks characteristic.

59f68d2f4e54.name: Gaze of the Gods
59f68d2f4e54.plain: This WARLORD has a 4+ invulnerable save, and whenever it attacks, it counts as engaged in all of Wanton Slaughter, Wanton Destruction and Wanton Massacre.

5a257dc95970.name: Lash of Torment
5a257dc95970.plain: When the Fight phase starts, you can pick one enemy unit within 3" of this model. That unit can't fight this phase until every eligible unit from your army has fought.

5ab28365c93a.name: The Cursed Crozius
5ab28365c93a.plain: Only a model with a power maul or an accursed crozius can have The Cursed Crozius, which replaces that weapon.

5b4906dffd81.name: Titanic
5b4906dffd81.plain: This model can declare a charge in a turn in which it Fell Back. Whenever it makes a Normal Move, Advances or Falls Back, it can move across other models (except Monster and Vehicle models) as if they weren't there, and while doing so it can move within Engagement Range of those models, but it can't end its move within Engagement Range of any of them.

5bba4e25f9a1.name: Talons of the Night Terror
5bba4e25f9a1.plain:
- Each time the bearer has finished a Normal Move or an Advance, pick one enemy unit it crossed over during this phase and roll a D6, subtracting 1 for a CHARACTER unit. On a 2+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.
- After the bearer finishes a charge move, pick one enemy unit within Engagement Range of it and roll a D6. On a 2+, that unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

5bfb561df8d1.name: Mark of Slaanesh
5bfb561df8d1.plain:
- This unit fights first in the Fight phase if, when that phase starts, it is within Engagement Range of any enemy units.
- While this unit has the ICON keyword, its models add 1 to the hit roll for each melee attack they make.

5d2d2729975e.name: Warp Strike
5d2d2729975e.plain: During deployment, you can place this unit in blasphemous reserves rather than on the battlefield. If you do, you can set it up during the Reinforcements step of any one of your Movement phases, anywhere more than 9" away from all enemy models.

5d40ca435a03.name: Reaver Lord
5d40ca435a03.plain: If this WARLORD is on the battlefield when your Command phase starts, roll one D6: a 4+ gives you 1 Command point.

5eea57c39db2.name: Vicious Descent
5eea57c39db2.plain: When one of your HOST RAPTORIAL units is placed on the battlefield at the end of the Movement phase: until the turn ends, you can re-roll hit rolls for that unit's attacks.

5f7664958f27.name: Death Hex
5f7664958f27.plain: Malediction: if this power is manifested, pick one enemy unit within 12" of this PSYKER. Until your next Psychic phase starts, that unit's models can't use invulnerable saves.

60069bf7071a.name: Explodes (6"/D6)
60069bf7071a.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within 6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

600d376bd2dc.name: Talisman of Burning Blood
600d376bd2dc.plain: The bearer gets 1 extra attack, gains another for each enemy unit it destroys in melee, and can make longer Heroic Interventions. It can perform a Heroic Intervention when an enemy unit is up to 6" away horizontally and 5" vertically, rather than the usual 3" horizontally and 5" vertically. Its Heroic Intervention move can be up to 6" long, provided it finishes either within Engagement Range of an enemy CHARACTER unit or closer to the nearest enemy model; all other Heroic Intervention rules still apply. Add 1 to its Attacks characteristic, and each time one of its melee attacks destroys an enemy unit, add a further 1 to its Attacks for the rest of the battle.

60ee7382768d.name: Sonic Weapon
60ee7382768d.plain: Each time an attack by this weapon targets a unit within half range, add 1 to that attack's Damage.

620c0dd4cc05.name: Dour Duty
620c0dd4cc05.plain: In any phase, when an attack targets an IRON WARRIORS CORE INFANTRY or IRON WARRIORS DAEMONKIN unit. For the rest of the phase, whenever an attack is allocated to one of that unit's HERETIC ASTARTES models, reduce that attack's Damage characteristic by 1 (to a minimum of 1). This Stratagem costs 2 CP if the unit has a Power Rating of 10 or more, otherwise 1 CP.

62bf757065c2.name: Lord of Slaanesh (Aura)
62bf757065c2.plain: Aura: while one of your <LEGION> SLAANESH CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

62ffd23af696.name: Drop Pod Assault
62ffd23af696.plain: During deployment, this unit has to be placed high in the skies instead of on the battlefield. It, and any units embarked in it, don't count towards any cap the mission sets on how many Reinforcement points your army can have. In the Reinforcements step of your first, second or third Movement phase, regardless of mission rules, you can place this unit anywhere on the battlefield that is more than 9" from all enemy models. After it is first placed on the battlefield, units embarked in it can disembark immediately; any that do must be placed more than 9" from all enemy models.

63524521ce09.name: Xyclos Needler
63524521ce09.plain: Each time an attack is made with this weapon against any unit other than a VEHICLE or TITANIC unit, an unmodified wound roll of 2+ always succeeds.

635d75bd15ee.name: Daemonic Whispers
635d75bd15ee.plain: This WARLORD may earn you a Command point each time it manifests a psychic power, gets a prayer heard, or completes an action or psychic action. Each time, roll one D6: if the result is higher than the number of the current battle round, you gain 1 Command point.

637dd0e5cdd3.name: Omen of Potency
637dd0e5cdd3.plain: If this prayer is heard, this PRIEST gets 3 extra attacks, and its melee weapons (not Relics) have their Armour Penetration improved by 2.

646f88cf2220.name: Tide of Traitors
646f88cf2220.plain: In your Command phase: pick one of your CULTISTS MOB units within 6" of either a battlefield edge or your deployment zone. You can return up to D3+3 destroyed models to it. These returned models can't be placed within Engagement Range of enemy units, except enemy units that are already within Engagement Range of that CULTISTS MOB unit.

649ba2dd7944.name: Wall-breakers
649ba2dd7944.plain: At the start of your Shooting phase: pick one of your DEVASTATION BATTERY units. Until the phase ends, you can re-roll damage rolls for that unit's ranged weapon attacks that target BUILDINGS.

64bed4bdfdb0.name: Winds of the Warp
64bed4bdfdb0.plain: In your opponent's Shooting phase, when one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES BIKER or TRAITORIS ASTARTES JUMP PACK units is chosen as the target of a ranged attack, if it Advanced in your previous Movement phase or was set up on the battlefield in the Reinforcements step of your previous Movement phase. For the rest of the phase, whenever an attack is made against that unit, subtract 1 from its hit roll.

6548da9db6d7.name: Implacable Taskmaster (Aura)
6548da9db6d7.plain: Aura: your IRON WARRIORS CORE units within 6" of this WARLORD that made a Normal Move still count as having Remained Stationary when they shoot. When such a unit is chosen to shoot, if it made a Normal Move in your previous Movement phase, it counts as having Remained Stationary until its shooting attacks have been resolved.

65a3b6df5a77.name: The Despoiler (Aura)
65a3b6df5a77.plain: Aura: while one of your CHAOS CORE units is within 6" of this model, add 1 to that unit's charge rolls, and re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

65d6fd9abadd.name: Explodes
65d6fd9abadd.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before any models embarked in it disembark and before taking it off the battlefield. On a 6, it explodes and every unit within D6+6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

663adae62b36.name: Raid Supply Lines
663adae62b36.plain: At the start of the Reinforcements step in your opponent's Movement phase, if your RED CORSAIRS WARLORD is on the battlefield: if it is the first or second battle round, you can pick one of your opponent's units that is in Strategic Reserves or is a Reinforcements unit. That unit can't arrive on the battlefield this phase for any reason, even if another rule says it always arrives during a specific battle round (such as Drop Pod Assault). You can use this Stratagem only once.

6692278838ea.name: Unending Horde
6692278838ea.plain: Roll one D6 each time a model in this unit would lose a wound: on a 6, that model doesn't lose it. Also, in your Command phase, you can add up to D3 destroyed models back to this unit. Models you return may only be placed in Engagement Range of an enemy unit that this unit is already in Engagement Range of.

66e446db77e0.name: Stabilisation Talons
66e446db77e0.plain: Models in this unit don't take the hit roll penalty for firing Heavy weapons in a turn when their unit moved.

6784e58e5089.name: Daemonkin Ritualists
6784e58e5089.plain: When you choose your army: pick one Chaos Space Marine Detachment in your army to be a Daemonkin Ritualists Specialist Detachment. In that Detachment, every DARK APOSTLES, DARK DISCIPLES, MASTERS OF POSSESSION, POSSESSED or GREATER POSSESSED unit gains the DAEMONKIN RITUALISTS keyword.

67c39c53270e.name: All is Dust
67c39c53270e.plain: Add 1 to armour saving throws made against attacks that have a Damage characteristic of 1 and are allocated to a model in this unit. In addition, models in this unit don't take the hit roll penalty for firing Heavy weapons in a turn when their unit moved.

684852911ade.name: Surgical Precision
684852911ade.plain: When this WARLORD attacks in melee, an unmodified hit roll of 4+ wounds the target automatically and improves that attack's Armour Penetration by 1.

68e082d8c9f2.name: Lord of Nurgle (Aura)
68e082d8c9f2.plain: Aura: while one of your <LEGION> NURGLE CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

6902c236fb66.name: Twin Falchion volcano cannon
6902c236fb66.plain: Blast. You can re-roll the wound roll for attacks this weapon makes against a TITANIC unit.

697b651804af.name: Herald's Talon
697b651804af.plain: You can re-roll the wound roll for each attack made with this weapon.

69ccea0990c6.name: Cabbalistic Rituals
69ccea0990c6.plain:
Your army is a Cabal of Sorcerers if every unit in it, not counting UNALIGNED units, has the THOUSAND SONS keyword. If it is, then at the start of each of your Psychic phases you gain Cabal points for every model on the battlefield that has this ability: Magnus the Red gives 4; Ahriman, an Exalted Sorcerer or a Thousand Sons Daemon Prince gives 3; a Sorcerer, Sorcerer in Terminator Armour or Infernal Master gives 2; a Scarab Occult Sorcerer, Aspiring Sorcerer or Tzaangor Shaman gives 1.

During your Psychic phase you may spend Cabal points on the Cabbalistic Rituals listed below, taking each ritual's cost off your total. Unspent Cabal points are lost when your Psychic phase ends.

Each Cabbalistic Ritual can be used once in your Psychic phase unless it says otherwise, and no unit of yours can benefit from more than one Cabbalistic Ritual. A unit without this ability can't benefit from a Cabbalistic Ritual.

If a ritual's timing mentions a 'unit from your army' (such as one used when a unit from your army is chosen to manifest psychic powers), that unit must have the THOUSAND SONS keyword for you to use it.

IMBUED MANIFESTATION (costs 4 Cabal points): use when one of your units successfully manifests a psychic power. The range of that power's effects goes up by 6" (if the power lists more than one range, such as Astral Blast, add 6" to the first range it lists).

MALEVOLENT CHARGE (costs 4 Cabal points): use when one of your units successfully manifests a psychic power. If that power inflicts mortal wounds on enemy units, once those mortal wounds are dealt, pick one of those units; it suffers D3 more mortal wounds.

KINDRED SORCERERS (costs 5 Cabal points): use after one of your units takes a Psychic test. Add 1 to that test.

WARP SIGHT (costs 3 Cabal points): use when one of your units successfully manifests a psychic power. If that power needs you to pick a unit visible to the PSYKER, for this manifestation you may pick a unit that any friendly unit with the Cabbalistic Rituals ability can see.

ECHOES FROM THE WARP (costs 4 Cabal points): use in your Psychic phase. Choose one of your PSYKER units. Until the phase ends, it can perform this psychic action: Echoes From the Warp (Warp Charge 3, Psychic Action): if it succeeds, you gain 1 Command point.

PACT FROM BEYOND (costs 7 Cabal points): use when one of your units attempts to manifest a psychic power. Don't take a Psychic test; the test counts as passed at the lowest warp charge value it needed.

CABBALISTIC FOCUS (costs 8 Cabal points): use after one of your units passes a Psychic test. That psychic power or psychic action can't be denied.

PSYCHIC MAELSTROM (costs 8 Cabal points): use when one of your units is chosen to manifest psychic powers. Until the phase ends, that unit may try to manifest one Witchfire psychic power that a different PSYKER from your army already attempted this phase, even if the unit doesn't know it and even though the same power normally can't be attempted more than once per Psychic phase.

WRATH OF THE IMMATERIUM (costs 9 Cabal points): use after one of your units takes a Psychic test. Add 2 to that test.

waive.MODELCABAL: table header 'MODEL / CABAL POINTS' run together in the source; the plain text lists each model's Cabal points instead

6a2c5f481b07.name: Wings
6a2c5f481b07.plain: The bearer has a 12" Move characteristic and the FLY keyword.

6c1732dbddb3.name: Twin hellstrike launcher
6c1732dbddb3.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll of attacks this weapon makes against an AIRCRAFT model, and its attacks that are allocated to an AIRCRAFT model have Damage D3+3.

6c9ffba66a1d.name: Explodes
6c9ffba66a1d.plain: If this model is destroyed, roll a D6 before taking it off the battlefield. On a 5+, it explodes and every unit within 2D6" takes D6 mortal wounds.

6ce2e7d79c4d.name: Eternal Vendetta (Aura)
6ce2e7d79c4d.plain: Aura: your <LEGION> CORE and <LEGION> CHARACTER units within 6" of this WARLORD can re-roll wound rolls against one enemy unit you pick. Choose that enemy unit as the first battle round starts, ahead of the first turn. For the rest of the battle, while one of your <LEGION> CORE or <LEGION> CHARACTER units is within 6" of this WARLORD, you can re-roll the wound roll whenever a model in that <LEGION> unit attacks the enemy unit you picked.

6d068dd2f9f1.name: Lord of Chaos (Aura)
6d068dd2f9f1.plain: Aura: while one of your <LEGION> CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

6d0d3f2c0157.name: Prime Test Subject
6d0d3f2c0157.plain: This WARLORD's Strength, Toughness and Wounds characteristics each go up by 1.

6d365cc92b56.name: The Hounds of Huron
6d365cc92b56.plain: In the Fight phase, after one of your RED CORSAIRS BIKER units has fought: if any enemy units are within Engagement Range of it, it can Fall Back as though it were your Movement phase. If not, a Normal Move is allowed instead, again as though it were your Movement phase.

6d8130ace18f.name: Impaler chainglaive
6d8130ace18f.plain: When the bearer made a charge move this turn, its attacks with this weapon get 1 added to their wound rolls.

6d9f700bd064.name: Icon of Flame
6d9f700bd064.plain: When your Psychic phase starts, you gain 1 extra Cabal point as long as the bearer is on the battlefield and your army is a Cabal of Sorcerers.

6dd14b17e740.name: Wrath of the Chosen
6dd14b17e740.plain: In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES TERMINATOR or CHOSEN units is chosen to shoot or fight. For the rest of the phase, add 1 to the hit roll of every attack made by a model in that unit.

6eb0f5b3e061.name: Lord of Khorne (Aura)
6eb0f5b3e061.plain: Aura: while one of your <LEGION> KHORNE CORE units is within 6" of this model, re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by models in that unit.

6f60532aa5d2.name: Ul'o'cca, the Black
6f60532aa5d2.plain: One of the bearer's melee weapons (not a Relic) becomes a Relic with the Daemon Weapon ability, and each attack with it that wounds also deals 1 mortal wound. You pick the weapon, and it counts as a Relic for all rules purposes. The mortal wound is dealt to the target on top of the attack's normal damage.

6f9643be7192.name: Ghorisvex's Teeth
6f9643be7192.plain: Only a model with an astartes chainsword can take this Relic. It replaces that chainsword and has its own weapon profile.

6fe1449b8464.name: Indomitable
6fe1449b8464.plain: Halve the Damage characteristic (rounding up) of each attack allocated to your WARLORD.

7045f03f15c7.name: Insidium
7045f03f15c7.plain: The bearer gets the DAEMON and DAEMONKIN keywords, and its Strength, Toughness and Wounds characteristics each go up by 1.

70ba9a45b79d.name: Reservoir of Daemonic Energy (Aura)
70ba9a45b79d.plain: Aura: add 1 to Psychic tests taken by any friendly <LEGION> PSYKER while it is within 9" of this model.

70fca4487c2b.name: Techinfernal Loci
70fca4487c2b.plain: With the DAEMON ENGINE keyword, this unit always counts as engaged in Wanton Destruction, Wanton Massacre and Wanton Slaughter; without it, it never does.

712ec8fab375.name: Daemonforge
712ec8fab375.plain: In your Shooting phase or the Fight phase, when one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES DAEMON ENGINE units is chosen to shoot or fight. Until the end of the phase, improve its models' Weapon Skill and Ballistic Skill characteristics by 1. This Stratagem costs 2 CP if that unit has the TITANIC keyword, otherwise 1 CP.

713f73038fac.name: Mindwitch
713f73038fac.plain: Knows Smite plus one psychic power from the Dark Hereticus discipline.

71c814d15461.name: Unrelenting Firepower
71c814d15461.plain: Models in this unit don't take the hit roll penalty for firing Heavy weapons in a turn when their unit moved. They can also make ranged attacks while their unit is in Engagement Range of enemy units, but only against enemy units their own unit is in Engagement Range of, and you subtract 1 from the hit roll of each such attack. When doing this, they can target an enemy unit even if other friendly units are also in Engagement Range of that enemy unit.

740a4d149757.name: Punishing Volley
740a4d149757.plain: If you did not take the first turn: at the end of your opponent's first Movement phase, pick one of your DEVASTATION BATTERY units. It can shoot right then, treating it as the Shooting phase.

7411c96f7117.name: Experimental Enhancements
7411c96f7117.plain: Models with this trait get 1" extra Move and 1 extra Strength, and on a 4+ can fight one last time when killed in melee. Add 1" to their Movement characteristic and 1 to their Strength characteristic. When a model with this trait is destroyed by a melee attack before it has fought this phase, roll one D6: on a 4+, leave it on the battlefield for now. It can fight once the attacking model's unit has made all its attacks, and is removed afterwards. While it makes these attacks, if any of its characteristics change as it loses wounds, use the profile for a model with 1 wound remaining.

745dda1c35bb.name: Apostle of the Dark Council
745dda1c35bb.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the WORD BEARERS keyword: pick one of your WORD BEARERS PRIEST models. Add 1 to that PRIEST model's Leadership characteristic, and it gains this ability: 'Dark Council: whenever this model chants a prayer, you can re-roll the dice to see whether the prayer is heard.' You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice if you are playing a Strike Force or Onslaught battle.

748a5925bae9.name: Vengeful Skies
748a5925bae9.plain: In your Command phase, if any of your BLACK LEGION CHARACTER models are on the battlefield: choose a point on the battlefield and put a marker there. At the start of your next Command phase, put a second marker within 12" of the first marker's centre, then draw a straight line from the centre of one marker to the centre of the other. Roll one D6 for each unit the line passes over or through. Add 1 to the roll if that unit has 11 or more models, and subtract 1 if it is a CHARACTER unit. On a 3+, the unit rolled for suffers D3 mortal wounds. Then remove the markers. You can use this Stratagem only once.

7538ee36ac09.name: Cult of the Damned
7538ee36ac09.plain: When you choose your army: pick one Chaos Space Marine Detachment in your army to be a Cult of the Damned Specialist Detachment. The DARK APOSTLES, DARK DISCIPLES and CHAOS CULTISTS in it get the CULT OF THE DAMNED keyword.

75723886931e.name: Excruciating Frequencies
75723886931e.plain:
In your Shooting phase, when one of your EMPEROR'S CHILDREN units is chosen to shoot:
- For the rest of the phase, whenever a model in that unit attacks with a sonic weapon, an unmodified wound roll of 6 inflicts 1 mortal wound on the target as well as the normal damage. A unit can't suffer more than 6 mortal wounds per phase from this Stratagem.
- Once that unit has finished its shooting attacks, pick one enemy unit that was hit this phase by a sonic weapon attack from a model in that unit. Until the start of your next turn, that enemy unit can't fire Overwatch or Set to Defend.

75f4a3a5ffa9.name: Disease Vectors
75f4a3a5ffa9.plain: If your army is Battle-forged, every DEATH GUARD or NURGLE TRAITORIS ASTARTES Patrol, Battalion and Brigade Detachment you have may take one GELLERPOX INFECTED unit and one MUTOID VERMIN unit without them filling Battlefield Role slots. These extra units don't prevent the rest of their Detachment from benefiting from Detachment abilities (for example Let the Galaxy Burn), nor do they prevent the rest of your army from using abilities that require all models in your army to have that ability. Any rule requiring all units in a Detachment to share at least one Faction keyword (as in a matched play game) ignores units added to a Patrol, Battalion or Brigade Detachment like this, and so does working out your Army Faction.

7628bd8a2c43.name: Hatred Unbound
7628bd8a2c43.plain: In your Command phase, if your BLACK LEGION WARLORD is on the battlefield and your army is engaged in Wanton Destruction, Wanton Massacre or Wanton Slaughter: pick one of your BLACK LEGION CORE units within 18" of your WARLORD. That unit counts as engaged in all three (Wanton Destruction, Wanton Massacre and Wanton Slaughter) until your next Command phase starts.

76a926133e7c.name: Vox Daemonicus (Aura)
76a926133e7c.plain: Aura: when an enemy unit within 12" of the bearer tries to do an action or psychic action, roll 2D6; if the total beats its Leadership, it can't attempt it.

77594e4710ae.name: Hunter in the Skies
77594e4710ae.plain: Add 1 to the hit roll of this model's attacks against units that can FLY.

775e7bafb8f5.name: Raiders from the Maelstrom
775e7bafb8f5.plain: Units with this trait can declare a charge after Advancing, and each of their models counts as two models when working out who controls an objective marker. A model with a Wounds characteristic of 10 or more counts as 5 models instead.

789399fc475b.name: Lightning claw
789399fc475b.plain: Each time the bearer fights, it gets 1 extra attack with this weapon. You can re-roll the wound roll for each attack made with this weapon.

78e95caf782b.name: Aspiring Lord
78e95caf782b.plain: Before the battle, while mustering your army, if your WARLORD has the TRAITORIS ASTARTES keyword: pick one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES CHARACTER models (not a named character) and give it one Warlord Trait it is allowed to have. That model counts as your WARLORD only for that Warlord Trait. Every Warlord Trait in your army must be different (re-roll duplicates if you generate them randomly), and you can't use this Stratagem to give one model two Warlord Traits. You can use this Stratagem only once, or twice in a Strike Force battle, or 3 times in an Onslaught battle.

78fe98dfbcd1.name: Frag Assault Launchers
78fe98dfbcd1.plain: Whenever this model completes a charge move within 1" of an enemy unit, roll one D6. On a 4+, the enemy unit suffers D3 mortal wounds.

7953863ef01c.name: Iconarch (Aura)
7953863ef01c.plain: Aura: while one of your <LEGION> CULTISTS units is within 6" of this unit's ICONARCH model, models in that unit add 2 to their Leadership, and you re-roll hit rolls of 1 for their attacks.

79d271292956.name: Warp-born Foresight
79d271292956.plain: At the end of the Reinforcements step in your opponent's Movement phase: pick one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES TZEENTCH units that is not within Engagement Range of any enemy units, then pick one enemy unit within 12" of it that was set up as Reinforcements this turn. That TZEENTCH unit may shoot as though it were your Shooting phase; if it does, its models can target only that enemy unit (and only if it is an eligible target).

7a054a89b72b.name: Melta array
7a054a89b72b.plain: Whenever the bearer fights, it gets 1 extra attack with this weapon, and it can't make more than one attack with this weapon.

7a152fcb1ace.name: Terrifying Phenomena
7a152fcb1ace.plain: At the start of the Morale phase: pick one enemy unit within 12" of one of your TRAITORIS ASTARTES CHAOS UNDIVIDED units. For the rest of the phase: your opponent can't pick that unit for the Insane Bravery Stratagem, and can't use any rule that lets them re-roll a Morale test for it; and any action that unit is performing fails immediately if it fails a Morale test.

7ac8fa557646.name: Souls of the Devoted
7ac8fa557646.plain: At the start of your Movement phase: pick one of your DAEMONKIN RITUALISTS POSSESSED units and one friendly DAEMONKIN RITUALISTS CHARACTER within 6" of it, and roll a D3. The POSSESSED unit suffers that many mortal wounds, and then the CHARACTER regains that many lost wounds.

7aff289cb7d6.name: Vox Daemonicus
7aff289cb7d6.plain: Enemy units can't be set up as reinforcements within 12" of the bearer.

7c14c042ef2e.name: Warp-sight Plea
7c14c042ef2e.plain: If this prayer is heard, one of your units within 6" of this PRIEST re-rolls ranged hit rolls of 1 and denies its targets the benefit of cover. Pick that unit from your <LEGION> CORE, <LEGION> CULTISTS or <LEGION> CHARACTER units; the effect applies to every ranged attack its models make.

7c561455c11e.name: Let the Galaxy Burn
7c561455c11e.plain:
This unit gets the rules below if every unit in your army has the TRAITORIS ASTARTES keyword (ignoring any AGENT OF CHAOS or UNALIGNED models) and all <LEGION> units in your army (other than ABADDON THE DESPOILER) come from the same Legion:
- Whenever a model in this unit fires a flame weapon, add 2 to the number of attacks that weapon makes this phase (for example, a flamer makes D6+2 attacks).
- This unit gets a bonus (described below) based on which wanton act it is engaged in:
- Battle round 1: your army and all of its units are engaged in Wanton Destruction.
- Battle round 2: your whole army, including each of its units, is engaged in Wanton Massacre.
- Battle round 3: when it starts, choose Wanton Massacre or Wanton Slaughter; until that battle round ends, your army and each unit in it is engaged in the act you chose.
- Battle round 4 and every later battle round: your army and all of its units are engaged in Wanton Slaughter.

7c5f47a6674b.name: Faithful Flock
7c5f47a6674b.plain: While this unit includes a CULT DEMAGOGUE model, it automatically passes every Morale test it takes.

7c64e44e8812.name: Unbound Arrogance
7c64e44e8812.plain: This WARLORD may gain 1 to 3 extra attacks when it fights, depending on a secret number contest with your opponent. Each time it is chosen to fight, you and your opponent each secretly pick a number from 1 to 3 on a D6, then reveal them at the same time. If the two numbers are different, add the number you picked to your WARLORD's Attacks characteristic until that fight is resolved.

7ca0c7cff80a.name: Sabotaged Armoury
7ca0c7cff80a.plain: In any phase, when an enemy VEHICLE model is destroyed: if any of your ALPHA LEGION units are on the battlefield, that model explodes automatically instead of your opponent rolling to see whether it explodes. If a rule says that model never explodes, ignore both that rule and this Stratagem, and roll for the explosion as normal.
